one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent successfully built and verified all three Cython extensions under NumPy 2.3.0 and Python 3.13, but the task was marked unresolved because step 13 emitted an informal echo string instead of the MiniSWE harness-recognized completion signal.
t_err_evidence: Step 13 uses 'echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT' as the completion signal; the terminal output is 'N/A', indicating the harness did not register any valid completion.
t_commit_evidence: Step 13 is the final step and the only completion action taken; by the end of this step the agent has no further actions, locking in the failure to emit a proper signal.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge of what specific completion command the MiniSWE evaluation harness requires. It used an informal echo string rather than whatever recognized protocol signal would have caused the harness to record the task as resolved.
